overview.description: The Amplify Top 10 Asia Memory ETF (AHBM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund tracks an index of that provides exposure to 10 Asian semiconductor companies through equity securities and swap agreements. The fund selects and weights securities based on its sector exposure and market share. AHBM was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
